name: Balance
a:
As a Reaction when you take damage, or when you use your Balance augment, you can steel yourself. You gain Resolution which lasts for 1 minute. While you have Resolution, you cannot be pushed, pulled, grappled, or gain the Proned condition unwillingly.

When you hit an Attack Roll, you can expend Resolution to gain temporary hit points equal to one roll of your weapon’s damage die, which is doubled if you are Bloodied.

name: Manipulate
a:
When you hit an attack with this weapon or with a spell while the target is within your Manipulate augment’s Range, you can choose to do one of the following:
- Force the target to drop one item of your choice that it's holding.
- Use your Manipulate augment on another target.
- Use an item that you have in your inventory.

If you choose to disarm the target, you can also choose to give it an item you have in your possession.
